data.narrative:
The Bot Company is a Series B robotics and manufacturing venture that has raised approximately $550M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, all operating within the Robotics & Manufacturing sector at similar or analogous stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $550M in total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B progression, yielding $1.0B. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—producing a median valuation of $1.8B with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. The stage-progression method reflects a more conservative capital-efficiency perspective, while the peer set anchors to observable market pricing for directly comparable assets.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $888M to $2.0B, with a median of $1.4B. Material uncertainty remains around the appropriate multiplier for stage progression, given limited visibility into The Bot Company's operational metrics relative to peers, and variation in how the broader peer set prices manufacturing automation maturity and deployment scope. The peer-median method carries greater weight given direct comparability, suggesting a central estimate toward the $1.6B–$1.8B band.
